description:
What We Once Only Imagined Is Now Real! A Robot That Draws Portraits

Hello, this is King Process.

The day has come when you can sit in front of a robot and have it draw your portrait. In this video, we show SketcherX, a portrait-drawing robot developed by the Korean company XORBIS, moving a pen to draw a person’s face.

Using a photograph, SketcherX creates a portrait that captures each person’s features, then moves its robotic arm to draw it on paper, stroke by stroke. It can also hold a conversation, so visitors can chat with the robot while waiting for their portraits.

SketcherX also drew portraits for visitors at the economic exhibition held during the 2025 APEC Summit in Gyeongju, Korea. At the event, it used the drawing style of Korean comic artist Lee Hyun-se, giving visitors the chance to see themselves drawn as comic characters.
